preconditions.description: The number of skewers n is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: The permutation p contains n integers, each between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(bi in [0, 1] for bi in b)
preconditions.description: The sequence b contains n integers, each either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of changes is non-negative.
The minimum number of changes does not exceed twice the number of skewers.
